heroHeadline: Reports Allege FIFA Knew Congo Fielded Ineligible Player vs. Nigeria in World Cup Qualifier
heroSubtitle: NYT, Le Monde and The Athletic report FIFA knew DR Congo goalkeeper Lionel Mpasi was ineligible yet let him play; Nigeria is reportedly weighing legal action. The FIFA Council meets Oct 15 to consider a governance review ahead of the March 2027 presidential election in Morocco.
